_readme: Public URLs for the published artefacts, used by the About page's download section. Kept as data so the links can be refreshed without touching src/.

downloads.blurb: The whole dataset — every record with its coordinates, precision tier, per-row sources and any correction applied to it.
GeoJSON, for dropping straight into QGIS, Felt, or any other map.
The network-complete bundle: cached upstream sources with checksums, the built web app, all 284 photographs, the tests and the docs. About 27 MB.
